row.Parse review: Original bed <80°C is a strict upper bound with no lower endpoint published; stored upper bound80 preserves that window, not approval to print at80. Nozzle250–280°C and non-heated chamber words are FFF guide settings, not compound extrusion temperatures. Original Nozzle material explicitly says compatible with standard brass nozzles; typed hardenedFALSE records that permission while the abrasion-text parser leaves an unstated abrasion result unknown. No abrasion measurement is inferred. Drying is conditional wet filament at80°C for at least12h in hot dry air oven; not annealing or pellet processing.

row.Finding: Its water uptake takes about 4 times longer to reach the saturation point compared to unmodified PA6, also its saturation point is 5 times lower than conventional PA6 materials.
row.Exposure / conditions: Literal own introduction comparison; no RH, temperature, duration, specimen dimensions, measured uptake or test standard printed. Moisture handling and service performance remain distinct. No hydrolysis or moisture selection pass; no multiplier applied to recorded absorption.
